conclusion: No blocking correctness finding for the bounded trusted-loopback scoped-v2 transport/store change.
reviewed_behavior: Composite (scope,key) SQLite lookup/insertion, receipt identity validation and per-scope authority prevent the demonstrated cross-scope key collision while preserving canonical keys.
Path/body scope and key mismatches fail before effect/attempt mutation; the HTTP adapter returns 400, and old v1 header/unscoped paths do not mutate the new store.

Same-scope duplicate returns historical receipt at count one, conflict returns 409, and a new effect requires current scoped authority. A revoked historical receipt remains observable without another effect.
Scoped hold identity permits a second scope with the same key to complete while the first committed reply is withheld; actual HTTP cancellation followed by lookup recovers the existing receipt.

Distinct v2 module/database/header preserves old fixture behavior. Legacy key-only schema rejection is verified against exact unchanged database bytes; both scoped effects remain count one after database reopen.

The opt-in wrapper injects the same lookup/apply interface into the existing immutable service. Its native composition is source-level evidence, and the dispatcher test explicitly uses an in-memory Harness double.
CI adds only the two Node test command lines in an existing Python/Node job. Existing complete Python discovery includes the seven new stdlib store tests.

node_execution_observed.scope: actual loopback HTTP/Python SQLite plus original dispatcher with in-memory Harness test double

limits: No native runtime session, native process restart, model/GPU, tenant authentication, distributed ownership or production validation was performed.
The existing failed concurrent native suite and all H1-H4 scientific outcomes remain unchanged.
Tests observe actual HTTP/SQLite fixture behavior plus mocked host recovery; they do not establish an atomic permission/network boundary.

initial_test_harness_cleanup_error.reason: New test held its own direct sqlite3 connection open; all behavior assertions passed but Windows temporary-directory cleanup failed. Test corrected to use the store closing context manager; no product code changed.
